semiconductor_relevance: High — Wings Global Technology Inc. specializes in photo-sensitive polyimide products that are critical for optoelectronic display devices in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Wings Global Technology Inc. focuses on the R&D and production of photo-sensitive polyimide (PSPI) products, which are essential for substrates in optoelectronic display devices. The company also offers customer-oriented adhesion promoter chemicals to address delamination issues, enhancing product quality and reducing costs for its clients.
capabilities: Photo Sensitive PolyImide (PSPI) products for optoelectronic displays
Adhesion promoter chemicals for PSPI applications
High electric insulating materials with low dielectric constant
